title: Webb County Tax Office announces Thanksgiving week schedule
excerpt: The Webb County Tax Office will close at 1 p.m. on Wednesday, November 25 for staff development, and will be closed Thursday, November 26 and Friday, November 27 for county holidays.
content:
The Webb County Tax Office has announced its schedule for Thanksgiving week.

The office will close at 1 p.m. on Wednesday, November 25, for staff development.

The office will be closed on Thursday, November 26, and Friday, November 27, for county holidays.

The Tax Office is asking residents to plan their visits accordingly and wished everyone a Happy Thanksgiving.

Source: Webb County Tax Office, Facebook, Nov. 18, 2026.

Webb Watch 956
